classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing leave request comments, including listing and creating comments, with integrated validation, permission checks, and data access logic.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveRequestCommentService instance used for comment operations.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the leave request ID from the URL parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list comments for a specific leave request, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing comments, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new comment to a leave request, performs validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a comment, including comment length and presence.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Populates a LeaveRequestComment entity with data from the request, such as comment text and timestamps.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Persists the LeaveRequestComment entity via the service/DAO layer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for deleting comments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for delete validation rules.
